task: ae.hash: Keccak/SHA-3/SHAKE, BLAKE2b/2s, HMAC, HKDF, PBKDF2 from scratch
reasoning_summary: Implemented Keccak-f[1600] with LFSR-derived round constants, BLAKE2b/2s with keyed and variable-length output, and generic HMAC/HKDF/PBKDF2 over a small Digest interface. Verified with Python hashlib literals (chain-of-lengths digests crossing every block/rate boundary), RFC 4231/5869/7914 vectors and JDK differential tests; a 48-mutant pass killed 45, the 3 survivors being provably equivalent.
